evaluation_epoch: Midpoint of each 24-hour observation day, GPST calendar labels. Both stations have identical published velocities, so the expected baseline is epoch-invariant.
tolerance_status: Conservative operational interpretation of specs/20 section 6 printed-source precision; the repository does not define a separate GNSS numerical threshold. This does not introduce a new acceptance criterion.
selection: A nonzero short baseline between separate NASA monuments, authoritative NGS ITRF2020 ARP coordinates and velocities, and publicly reusable NOAA observations. Day 001 chosen before solving; day 002 added as a discrepancy diagnostic. No epochs or days selected to meet the threshold.
